{"findings":[{"lang":"en","severity":2,"kind":"overlap","where":"top bar, right end","problem":"The orange Weekly challenge button covers another control that sits behind it (its outline shows above and left of the button), probably the language switcher, so that control is hidden."},{"lang":"he","severity":2,"kind":"overlap","where":"top bar, left end","problem":"The orange challenge button covers another control behind it (an outline shows at its top and right edge), and the language icon sits right next to it."},{"lang":"en","severity":1,"kind":"notch","where":"top right, Weekly challenge button","problem":"The button extends to about 10 px from the right screen edge, so a notch or rounded corner could cover part of it."},{"lang":"he","severity":1,"kind":"notch","where":"top left, challenge button","problem":"The button sits about 8 px from the left screen edge, so a notch or rounded corner could cover part of it."}]}
